hypothesis: Inertial mass and gravitational mass are not merely proportional but strictly identical in nature, such that any locally uniform gravitational field is physically indistinguishable from a uniformly accelerating reference frame; consequently, gravity is not a force acting within spacetime but a geometric property of spacetime itself, where the presence of energy-momentum curves the spacetime manifold and free bodies follow geodesics of that curved geometry.
mechanism: Because the rule guarantees that all inertial frames are equivalent and force-free bodies move uniformly, and because gravitational and inertial mass are identical, an observer in a closed laboratory cannot distinguish gravitational pull from uniform acceleration. A photon climbing the tower must 'do work against' the effective pseudo-force experienced in the equivalent accelerating frame, causing its wavefronts to arrive at lower frequency—a direct blueshift-in-reverse predicted by the equivalence. Clocks at different gravitational potentials correspond to clocks at different positions in an accelerating frame: the leading clock (higher up, further from the 'floor') accumulates more proper time per coordinate interval, producing the observed rate difference proportional to the potential gap.
observations_explained: Light-ray deflection near massive bodies: geodesics in curved spacetime bend, so starlight passing the Sun is deflected by twice the Newtonian prediction.
Perihelion precession of planetary orbits beyond Newtonian accounting, arising from curvature corrections to geodesic motion.
Frame-dragging effects (Lense-Thirring) where rotating masses drag the local inertial frame.
Gravitational time dilation in GPS satellite systems requiring relativistic corrections for accurate positioning.
Gravitational wave emission from accelerating mass distributions as ripples in the spacetime metric.
Shapiro delay: radar signals passing near massive bodies arrive later than flat-spacetime prediction due to metric elongation of the path.
parsimony_justification: The hypothesis introduces only one new ontological commitment—the identity of inertial and gravitational mass, from which curved-spacetime geometry follows without any additional gravitational force field, carrier particle, or separate interaction law; it absorbs Newtonian gravity as a low-curvature limit rather than adding a new fundamental force.
novelty_justification: Rather than treating the frequency shift as a consequence of a photon losing energy to a conventional gravitational potential (a retrieval-level force-field answer), the abductive step reframes gravity itself as spacetime curvature inferred from the logical entailment of inertial-gravitational mass equivalence together with the invariance of physical laws across inertial frames—a structural reconceptualization of what 'gravity' is, not merely a quantitative correction.

candidate_survey.label: retrieval
candidate_survey.description: Photons carry energy E=hf and thus an effective gravitational mass; climbing a gravitational potential well they lose energy, so frequency drops. Clocks run slower in lower potential wells because of this energy cost. This is the standard energy-conservation/gravitational-potential-well explanation requiring no reinterpretation of gravity.

candidate_survey.label: historical_decoy
candidate_survey.description: A scalar relativistic theory of gravity treats gravitation as a Lorentz-invariant scalar field modifying only the rate of physical processes (clock rates, atomic frequencies) but not spatial geometry; it correctly predicts gravitational redshift but fails on light deflection and perihelion precession, and was historically proposed and then abandoned.

candidate_survey.label: abductive
candidate_survey.description: The strict identity of inertial and gravitational mass entails that gravity is entirely equivalent to acceleration in any local region, forcing the conclusion that gravity is not a force within flat spacetime but the curvature of spacetime itself; the frequency shift and clock-rate difference are then direct geometric consequences of photons and clocks traversing regions of differing spacetime curvature generated by the Earth's mass-energy.
